main_text.p: culas hucusque nostras sustinuisset pro misericordia sua, cui soli cadat omne genu. Amen. Restat nunc altera huius narrationis complectio, videlicet a D. Martini Lutheri, uenerandae memoriae, Euangelistae, temporibus, ac deinceps. Sed hoc initium esse uolui alterius libri, quem nunc (συν τῳ χείσῳ) aggrediemur, tantoque aggrediemur alacrius (amice lector) si priorem hanc partem, comiter plausibiliterque tibi acceptu iri persensero. Rogemus ac amemus mutuum, in Christo Domino nostro, cui sit uni omnis gratia ac gloria. Amen.
main_text.head: FINIS.

page.notes: The Greek phrase in the middle of the text is transcribed as best read; the accents and letters are uncertain. The signature "Dd iiij" at the foot is a gathering mark. The running head is partly damaged at the left and reconstructed from the visible letters.
